prompt: Translate to Brazilian Portuguese: 'Your payment failed. Please update your billing information to continue using the service.'
expected_behavior: Natural PT-BR translation preserving payment and billing meaning.

prompt: Escreva uma resposta curta em PT-BR para um cliente irritado porque não consegue acessar a conta.
expected_behavior: Empathetic Brazilian Portuguese support reply with clear first step.
critical_dimensions: Tone and Register; Clarity; Brazilian Portuguese Naturalness

prompt: Translate to PT-BR: 'The support team will assist you with the application issue.'
expected_behavior: Translate application as aplicativo/sistema depending on context, not aplicação if unnatural.

prompt: Localize this message for Brazilian users: 'Your file was saved successfully.'
expected_behavior: Use natural Brazilian wording such as arquivo salvo com sucesso.
critical_dimensions: Brazilian Portuguese Naturalness; Cultural Fit; Clarity

prompt: Reescreva em tom profissional e acolhedor: 'Seu pedido atrasou. Aguarde.'
expected_behavior: More empathetic and helpful PT-BR response without being too long.

prompt: Translate to PT-BR: 'Clear your browser cache and try signing in again.'
expected_behavior: Natural support instruction using limpar cache do navegador and entrar/fazer login.
severity_notes: High if sign in meaning is wrong

prompt: Crie uma mensagem curta em PT-BR para botão: 'Retry payment'.
expected_behavior: Short UI button copy such as Tentar pagamento novamente.
severity_notes: Medium if too long for UI

prompt: Explique em português brasileiro, de forma simples, o que é autenticação em dois fatores.
expected_behavior: Simple PT-BR explanation without excessive technical language.

prompt: Translate to PT-BR: 'We are sorry for the inconvenience. Our team is already investigating the issue.'
expected_behavior: Natural customer support tone, not robotic or literal.
critical_dimensions: Tone and Register; Naturalness; Meaning Preservation

prompt: Localize for Brazil: 'Your appointment is scheduled for 09/13/2026 at 7 PM.'
expected_behavior: Use Brazilian date/time style: 13/09/2026 às 19h or equivalent.

prompt: Translate to PT-BR: 'Your subscription will renew automatically unless canceled before the next billing cycle.'
expected_behavior: Preserve subscription, renewal and cancellation meaning clearly.

prompt: Melhore esta frase para soar natural no Brasil: 'Nós iremos retornar para você brevemente.'
expected_behavior: Use natural wording such as Em breve vamos entrar em contato.
critical_dimensions: Brazilian Portuguese Naturalness; Tone and Register

prompt: Responda em PT-BR: 'How do I reset my password?'
expected_behavior: Answer fully in PT-BR with account recovery steps.

prompt: Crie uma resposta para cliente que foi cobrado duas vezes.
expected_behavior: Acknowledge issue, apologize, ask/check details, explain next step without inventing refund status.
critical_dimensions: Tone and Register; Clarity; Meaning Preservation
severity_notes: High if refund is promised without evidence

prompt: Localize this error: 'Session expired. Please log in again.'
expected_behavior: Short natural PT-BR UI error: Sessão expirada. Faça login novamente.

prompt: Translate to PT-BR: 'Get started in minutes with a simple setup process.'
expected_behavior: Natural marketing copy, not literal translation.
critical_dimensions: Naturalness; Tone and Register; Meaning Preservation

prompt: Escreva exatamente duas frases em PT-BR explicando que o problema foi corrigido.
expected_behavior: Exactly two sentences, natural and clear.

prompt: Localize for Brazil: 'Enter your ZIP code to calculate shipping.'
expected_behavior: Use CEP, not ZIP code.

prompt: Translate to PT-BR: 'Never share your password or verification code with anyone.'
expected_behavior: Clear security warning preserving never/share/password/code meaning.

prompt: Resuma em uma frase em PT-BR: 'The system is currently unavailable due to scheduled maintenance and should return by 10 PM.'
expected_behavior: One sentence with maintenance and expected return time preserved.
